name: Lost in the Hole
summary: The horror game set in the 1970s takes players to an abandoned, futuristic laboratory. The story revolves around a biological experiment gone wrong, resulting in the lab's employees turning into mutant creatures. The goal is to get deep into the lab and obtain the mysterious sample. In the abandoned but living world of the lab, surprises await around every corner, as the retro style of the 70s meets futuristic sci-fi elements.
